name: NextMind
headline: One company, the whole picture.
intro: Long-form video deep dives on the businesses behind the brands, the products and the headlines.
about: NextMind is a YouTube series about companies. Each episode follows one business from its founding to today: how it makes money, the decisions that shaped it, and what could change next.
Every episode page carries the chapters, the key numbers and the sources behind them.
